## [0.1.2] - 2026-11-28

## [0.1.1] - 2026-11-28

### Bug Fixes

- Never turn a memory notice into a question form (d92effd)
- Keep the memory cycle off and tell the user to run /memory-setup when no config exists (8cae508)

### Maintenance

- Mark the release phase done (58a2e7f)

## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-28

### Maintenance

- Name the npm account the release publishes as (a41996b)
- Release the version in package.json as the first release (6a8fb79)
- Assert compaction coverage instead of racing notice counts (4154b58)
- Wait for the opencode server to exit before removing its folder (d6f6edc)
- Check out files with lf endings (8f68d00)
- Fix the OpenCode CLI check step yaml (a9de860)
- Add CI and release workflows (4077b67)
